# cloptima_telemetry_key (Resource)

Issues a Cloptima telemetry key with the telemetry:write scope for sending LLM usage telemetry. Every attribute change replaces the key and issues a new token. A key revoked or expired outside Terraform is recreated on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_telemetry_key" "collector" {
  name            = "datadog-telemetry-forwarder"
  expires_in_days = 90
}

# The telemetry access token is used to stream usage events and traces
output "telemetry_access_token" {
  value     = cloptima_telemetry_key.collector.access_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for this telemetry key, at least 3 characters.

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Application attribution label.
- `environment` (String) Environment attribution label (e.g. production, staging).
- `expires_in_days` (Number) Token lifetime in days, from 1 to 3650. Defaults to 3650 days. This value is not returned by Cloptima, so it stays null after import; set it to match expires_at or add it to ignore_changes to avoid replacing an imported key.
- `team_id` (String) Team attribution label.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The telemetry key token. Available only in the state of the apply that created the key; it is not recovered on import.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp.
- `id` (String) Telemetry key ID.
- `scopes` (List of String) Access scopes granted to this key.
- `status` (String) Key status.
- `token_prefix` (String) Non-secret prefix of the telemetry key, safe to log.
